start.README.md:
# Layered configuration

`<env>.conf` is the entry point of an environment. A line `include PATH` is replaced by the contents of
that file, at that position. All other lines are `key = value`. When a key is set more than once in the
expanded result, the **last** setting wins. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
start.apac.conf:
# entry point for apac
include conf.d/quartz29.conf
log_level = info
start.conf.d/ember50.conf:
# layer ember50
include conf.d/tundra80.conf
shard_count = 327
queue_depth = 729
cache_ttl_s = 52
start.conf.d/garnet34.conf:
# layer garnet34
include conf.d/ember50.conf
shard_count = 69
pool_max = 856
cache_ttl_s = 246
start.conf.d/marble97.conf:
# layer marble97
include conf.d/garnet34.conf
cache_ttl_s = 317
pool_max = 36
start.conf.d/quartz29.conf:
# layer quartz29
include conf.d/harbor59.conf
pool_max = 773
log_sample_rate = 489
start.conf.d/tundra80.conf:
# layer tundra80
include conf.d/pebble85.conf
queue_depth = 234
batch_size = 417

gold_answer: `shard_count` is 69 for apac; it is set in conf.d/garnet34.conf.

# Layered configuration

`<env>.conf` is the entry point of an environment. A line `include PATH` is replaced by the contents of
that file, at that position. All other lines are `key = value`. When a key is set more than once in the
expanded result, the **last** setting wins. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
